summary: Susan Winchester is an Oklahoma native from Chickasha who earned bachelor's and master's degrees at the University of Oklahoma. She co-owned two aviation-related businesses from 1976 to 1989, then worked in adult training at a technology center. In 1992 she founded Winchester Group, an educational training and consulting firm.
one_line: Susan Winchester, born in Chickasha, Oklahoma, co-ran aerial businesses, worked in adult training, and in 1992 founded the consulting firm Winchester Group.
key_facts: Susan Winchester was born in Chickasha, Oklahoma.
Susan Winchester earned her bachelor's and master's degrees at the University of Oklahoma.
Susan Winchester co-owned and operated American Dusting Company from 1976 to 1989.
Susan Winchester co-owned and operated Chickasha Flying Service from 1976 to 1989.
After 1989, Susan Winchester worked as a coordinator for Adult Training and Development at Canadian Valley Technology Center.
In 1992 Susan Winchester started Winchester Group.
Winchester Group is an educational group that provides training and consulting to businesses.
